# Vendor references

Files in this directory are third-party reference snapshots. They are kept for
offline implementation research and are not EncoreHub API contracts.

## OpenAI

`openai-openapi-reference.yaml` is the OpenAI OpenAPI snapshot that previously
lived at `docs/openapi.yaml`. Its embedded metadata identifies version `2.3.0`,
the OpenAI API server, upstream documentation, terms, and license. The exact
import date is not recorded; it was present when the repository audit was
performed on 2026-07-12.

Use [the EncoreHub Gateway contract](../openapi.json) for project routes.
Changes to the vendor snapshot do not define or modify EncoreHub behavior.
